text:
Emma S: FYI escalating INC-8421 — ACME reports repeated invalid JSON from /v1/generate. Happens intermittently after burst traffic. Sample attached. :grimacing:

Raj P: Can you paste request_id and sample response?

Emma S: request_id=rid_0a3f2e, customer session_id=cust-acme-112. Here's raw response:
```
HTTP 200
{ "result": { "user": "alice", "items": [
  {"id": 1, "name": "widget"}
]},}{"result": {"user": "bob", "items": [
  {"id": 2, "name": "gadget"}
]}}
```
(not valid JSON — two objects mashed and leftover comma)

Raj P: ugh. Any env details? Model, batch settings, prefix caching?

Emma S: Model=redwood-v2-large, endpoint=/v1/generate, structured_output=true, batch_max=16, concurrency=8, kv_prefix_cache=on, streaming=false. Customer on Dedicated (us-east). Latency spikes ~600ms during incidents.

Sam O: I see deploy-bot pushed a runtime change 2025-11-09T04:12Z that touched packer/batcher. @deploy-bot can you confirm? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deployment id=dp_9934, commit=3f2b9a, rollout=100% to us-east at 2025-11-09T04:12:18Z

Alyssa M: This looks like a race between prefix cache reads and batch assembly. We've seen 'object concatenation' when two sessions reuse the same cache key and the assembler doesn't reset buffer boundaries.

Raj P: Could reproduce locally? Steps?

Alyssa M: Repro caveats: need burst with concurrency >4, prefix_cache enabled, structured mode with multiple JSON objects streaming in same batch. Repro curl:
```
for i in {1..30}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-large","structured_output":true,"input":"{\"session\":$i}\n","max_tokens":60}' &
 done; wait
```
Will see interleaved JSON in responses when batcher merges partials.

Emma S: Customer tried disabling prefix cache and issue stopped. But they don't want that permanent due to cost.

Sam O: Short-term mitigation: set batch_max=1 or turn off kv_prefix_cache at edge for that customer. Ops can do per-tenant override.

Raj P: For a proper fix, we need to ensure batch assembly zeroes buffers per request and add a cache key namespace per session to avoid reuse. Alyssa, can you prototype a unit test that simulates partials from two sessions?

Alyssa M: On it. I'll push a test and a patch to guard buffer boundaries. PR target next week. Also adding an integration test that runs above burst loop in CI.

Emma S: Customer update: they paused traffic and accepted temporary kv cache off. They're worried about billing for retries — CS is handling billing credit request.

Sam O: Assigning incident tag INC-8421 -> eng-runtime + eng-ml. @Raj P you'll own runtime fix? :thumbsup:

Raj P: I'll take runtime. Starting triage now. Will follow up with timeline.

Emma S: Thanks all. Will post logs/attachments in the ticket. 👍
